clues: This is a mountain resort town in north Punjab, in Pakistan. It sits under the west Himalayas.
In summer, British troops left the fierce heat of the plains for this hill town. Its high ground was a place to rest and heal.
Work to build this town began in 1851. It was made as a health rest place for British troops.
This small hill town once ran a whole province in summer. British rulers of Punjab moved their capital here for the season.
Look for the Pir Panjal Range in northern Punjab. This mountain resort town sits in its Galyat hills.
